description: A jQuery plugin implementing autocomplete functionality, including cache management, UI rendering, and event handling for text inputs and textareas.

classes.name: Autocompleter
classes.description: Main class handling autocomplete logic, cache, and UI interactions.

classes.name: Autocompleter.Cache
classes.description: Handles caching of autocomplete results for performance optimization.

classes.name: Autocompleter.Select
classes.description: Manages the dropdown list UI, navigation, and selection of autocomplete options.

classes.name: Autocompleter.Selection
classes.description: Utility for selecting text ranges within input fields.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Initializes autocomplete on selected input elements with URL or data and options.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Binds a handler for when a result is selected.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Updates the options for the autocomplete instance.

methods.name: unautocomplete
methods.description: Removes autocomplete functionality from the element.
